chars.TROLL: TROLL: a chubby young man wearing round black glasses, a bright red tracksuit jacket with two white stripes on the sleeves, and a backwards black cap.
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the open doorway of his small messy bedroom in Casablanca at night: TROLL sits at a desk, caught mid-act, head-to-waist framing, face visible turned three-quarters toward us, laughing with his mouth wide open while clicking the mouse to upload a video, the laptop screen glowing blue (screen shows only abstract shapes). Gaming chair, LED strip light, posters without text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on a Moroccan living-room sofa with patterned cushions, scrolling his phone, eyebrows raised in surprise, leaning forward. Afternoon light from a window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close-up head-to-waist: NARRATOR stares at his phone in shock, mouth open, one hand gripping his head, the phone glow on his face. Living room background blurred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: TROLL at his desk speaks into a small podcast microphone, laughing hard and pointing mockingly at his laptop screen (abstract shapes only), head-to-waist, face visible. Messy bedroom at night with LED light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands in his living room facing the viewer, both palms open upward in a questioning gesture, confused and worried expression, phone in one hand.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night: NARRATOR paces in a dim bedroom, rubbing his forehead, phone in hand, stressed. Moonlight through the window, an unmade bed in the background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on the edge of his bed looking down at his phone with a sad, tired face, shoulders dropped. Soft lamp light, quiet bedroom.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Daytime on a Casablanca rooftop terrace with white walls and laundry lines: NARRATOR faces the viewer and talks warmly, one finger raised like giving advice, calm smile.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a café in Casablanca: NARRATOR gently puts his open palm toward the viewer like politely refusing to be filmed, friendly but firm face. Mint tea glasses on the small table.
